{{Top|leg}}
The '''Clandestine Operative Act''' was a statute in effect during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that allowed individuals to file false information regarding their movements while engaging in covert activities on behalf of the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
